promotionalText: A quiet space. Three perspectives. Explore gentle guidance, a playful challenger and two voices for your dilemmas. Keep the words that stay with you.
description:
Some days you need a gentle voice. Others, a different angle.

Meet Heaven & Hell, the new experience inside God & Devil: a space for AI reflection, perspective and a moment to breathe.

THREE WAYS TO REFLECT
• God: a compassionate fictional companion inspired by biblical themes.
• Devil: a playful fictional challenger who helps you question your assumptions.
• Two voices: explore one dilemma through both perspectives, followed by a question for your own reflection.

MAKE IT YOUR SPACE
Save meaningful replies in your journal, share the reflections you choose, return to recent conversations, and take a one-minute guided breathing pause. Choose Romanian, English, German or Norwegian. Optional daily reminders help you return on your own terms.

START FREE
Try up to 10 God replies, 3 Devil replies and 1 Two voices reply each day. Allowances reset at 00:00 UTC. The journal and breathing ritual are available without a subscription.

PREMIUM
The monthly subscription includes up to 100 AI replies per day across all three modes and optional evening reminders. There are no ads. The localized price and subscription period appear before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account after confirmation. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

YOUR CHOICES MATTER
Before sending a message, the app asks permission to share that message and recent conversation context through our Cloudflare-hosted server with OpenAI. Local conversation history and saved reflections stay on your device. Withdraw AI sharing permission or delete local conversations and journal entries in Settings.

These are fictional AI companions for reflection and entertainment, not actual supernatural contact or professional advice. AI can make mistakes. You remain the author of your choices.

notes:
Guideline 5 — China mainland availability

In response to submission f03b7fd2-355a-4f4d-85ca-2dc178e682b3, China mainland was deselected in App Store Connect App Availability on November 14, 2026. We selected the alternative remedy described in your review: the app will not be distributed through the China mainland storefront. All other territory selections remain unchanged. Version 1.1.0 (16) retains AI functionality and transparent OpenAI disclosures for the remaining storefronts.

Testing the app
No app account sign-in is required. Choose God, Devil or Two voices from the home screen. Before the first message, the app requests explicit permission to send that message and recent context through our Cloudflare-hosted API to OpenAI. Users can decline or withdraw permission in Settings. The characters are explicitly fictional AI companions.

The live AI service has available API credit and has been verified with real replies in Romanian, English, German and Norwegian, conversation context and the Two voices JSON response. Premium availability is enabled. The monthly product is com.gabriellivadariu.goddevilchat.premium.monthly.v2 (RevenueCat entitlement: premium). The paywall displays the localized store price and provides Restore Purchases. Free daily allowances are 10 God replies, 3 Devil replies and 1 Two voices reply; Premium allows 100 replies per day across modes. Daily allowances reset at 00:00 UTC.

Please reassess the submission with the updated availability settings.

The localized price, test purchase and Restore Purchases have also been verified in TestFlight version 1.1.0 (16).
